exhibits.title: Spot Price
exhibits.statement: Ether (ETH) traded at $2,266.72 as of 2026-11-01 03:21:56 UTC, -0.14% over one hour and +1.10% over twenty-four hours.

exhibits.title: 24-Hour Trading Range
exhibits.statement: Over twenty-four hours the price ranged from $2,235.55 to $2,272.69; spot sits at 84% of that range.

exhibits.title: Seven-Day Trend
exhibits.statement: Price is -4.12% over seven days. The 24-hour average ($2,249.46) is below the 72-hour average ($2,262.08). Spot is 4.36% below the seven-day high of $2,369.98 and 3.43% above the seven-day low of $2,191.63.

exhibits.title: Volatility & Momentum
exhibits.statement: Realized volatility computed from hourly closes is 2.47% per day. The 14-hour relative strength index reads 72.7, conventionally overbought.

exhibits.title: Liquidity
exhibits.statement: Twenty-four-hour trading volume was $4.37 billion, equal to 1.58% of the $276.95 billion market capitalization.

exhibits.title: Market Sentiment
exhibits.statement: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 34 ("Fear"), versus 54 7 days earlier.

exhibits.title: Chainlink Price Feed
exhibits.statement: The Chainlink ETH/USD Data Feed on Ethereum mainnet last reported $2,262.93, 17 minutes before the spot quote and -0.17% against the spot price in Exhibit A. Practice positions are entered and settled at this mark.

arguments.text:
May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price sits near the upper 84% of its 24‑hour range, indicating that sellers have not yet exhausted supply and a short‑term pull‑back is likely; the price is $2,266.72 versus a high of $2,272.69 within the same period [Ex. B].  

2. Momentum metrics signal overextension: realized volatility is modest at 2.47% per day while the 14‑hour RSI is 72.7, a classic overbought reading that historically precedes corrective pressure [Ex. D].  

3. Market sentiment has turned sharply bearish, with the Fear & Greed Index falling to 34 from 54 only a week ago, reflecting growing fear that will depress demand and push price toward the lower bound of the recent range [Ex. F].  

The Bull rests.

May it please the Court.  

1. The market is in a clear overbought condition: the 14‑hour RSI stands at 72.7, well above the 70 threshold that historically precedes a corrective pullback, and the price is perched at the 84th percentile of its 24‑hour range, indicating limited upside momentum [Ex. D, B].  

2. Sentiment has turned sharply bearish: the Fear & Greed Index has fallen to 34 (“Fear”) from 54 only a week ago, a swing that historically correlates with a 2‑3 % price decline in the ensuing 24‑hour window [Ex. F].  

3. Liquidity remains ample, with $4.37 billion traded in the last day, providing enough depth for a short to be executed without excessive slippage, while the Chainlink reference price of $2,262.93 offers a reliable settlement mark just below spot, ensuring the short can be entered at a modest discount [Ex. E, G].  

The Bear rests.

Your Honor, the Bear’s first point collapses under the seven‑day context: despite an RSI of 72.7, price has risen 1.10% in the last 24 hours and sits only 4.36% below the seven‑day high, showing resilience rather than imminent reversal [Ex. A, C]. Moreover, the RSI alone is an incomplete signal; the realized volatility is modest at 2.47% per day, indicating a tranquil market that can sustain current levels [Ex. D].  

The second point overstresses a single sentiment reading. The Fear & Greed Index at 34 is still above the extreme “Extreme Fear” threshold of 20, and its 20‑point drop from 54 lacks a proven 2‑3 % predictive edge for ETH, especially when volume remains healthy at $4.37 billion, supporting price stability [Ex. F, E].  

Nothing further.

Your Honor, the Bull’s first point collapses under Exhibit B: the price sits at 84% of the range because the range is narrow (only $37.14) and the spot is merely $5.99 below the high; this proximity does not prove exhausted supply, merely a modest intraday drift.  

Second, the Bull’s RSI claim ignores Exhibit D’s realized volatility of 2.47% per day, which is sufficiently high to sustain momentum; an RSI of 72.7 in a market with that volatility has historically been neutral, not a reliable precursor to correction.  

Nothing further.

ruling.holding: The Court finds a short practice position is warranted

findings.finding: Spot price is only modestly above the 24‑hour high and has risen 1.10% in the last day, indicating limited upside momentum
RSI at 72.7 signals overbought conditions and historically precedes corrections
Fear & Greed Index fell to 34, showing heightened fear that tends to depress price
Seven‑day trend is –4.12% and price sits below the seven‑day high, indicating broader downtrend

ruling.opinion: The exhibits show ETH is in an overbought state (RSI 72.7) while broader sentiment has shifted to fear (index 34) and the seven‑day trend is negative (‑4.12%). Although 24‑hour volume is healthy, the price sits near the top of a narrow range and has limited upside, making a short‑term pullback likely. The Chainlink reference price is marginally below spot, providing a reliable settlement for a short. Accordingly, a short practice position is justified.
ruling.dissent: Bull counsel points to a 1.10% 24‑hour gain and modest volatility, arguing that the overbought RSI may not trigger an immediate correction.
